high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article or a section from a website discussing the views of Yann LeCun on large language models (LLMs). The text at the top of the image provides context about LeCun's perspective on LLMs, stating that he believes they are not a credible path toward human-level intelligence. He describes them as limited "autocomplete machines" lacking foundational cognitive abilities such as reasoning, planning, and causal understanding. Below the text, there is a graphic with the title "EASY GUIDE TO WHAT IS LLM.
